as_of_content:
'''Teletraan-I''' is a [[Bots|Cybertronian]] Network used by the [[Autobots]] in various [[Story|Missions]]. At the start of the game, [[Optimus Prime]] asks Teletraan-I if he can identify his current location, but then Teletraan-I replies that [[New Quintessa]] had no match to the Cybertronian planet database.

Teletraan-I is also responsible for teaching the player to use verious Items and Resources, as well as how to upgrade [[Bots]] using [[Ore-13]].
[[Category:Autobots]]
